image.title: Dante and Beatrice
image.creator: Henry Holiday
image.attribution: Henry Holiday, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: The Victorian image of Dante seeing Beatrice on a Florentine bridge

summary.en: Florentine woman, daughter of the banker Folco Portinari, whom Dante loved from childhood. He made her the centre of the Vita Nuova after her early death in 1290. No portrait of her from life survives; the images are all imagined.

en: Daughter of Folco Portinari, a Florentine banker
